linkedin_angles.draft:
Owned, not licensed: Why community colleges should build their own AI infrastructure

Students at well-resourced four-year universities are already living in an AI-enabled campus. Advisors have dashboards. Faculty have tools that flag disengaging students before the withdrawal deadline. Students have AI environments tailored to their programs...

This seems less like a one-off story than a small sign of the pressure now being placed on colleges to do more, explain more, and absorb more complexity.

For community colleges, the question is whether the implementation capacity matches the ambition.
